ORAL ORDER

1. Accused in Special Case No.2386/2025 pending before the Court of XXXIII Addl. City Civil and Sessions Judge and Special Judge (NDPS), Bengaluru, arising out of F.No.DRI/BZU/IV/ENQ-25/(INT-INL)/2025 registered by the respondent for the offences punishable under Sections 8(c), 21(c), 23(c), 28 and 29 of the NDPS Act, 1985, is before this Court in this petition filed under Section 483 of BNSS, 2023, seeking regular bail.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

3. It is the case of the prosecution that based on credible information that the petitioner, who is an African citizen, who had traveled from Jaipur to Bengaluru in a bus was illegally carrying contraband article in her bag, on 28.05.2025 at about 11.00 a.m. petitioner was apprehended and from her possession 7533 grams of contraband article allegedly amphetamine was recovered and seized under a panchanama. Subsequently, petitioner was arrested and remanded to judicial custody.
